company.name: Metriport
company.shortDescription: Metriport is a healthcare data infrastructure company that provides tools for accessing, integrating, and analyzing patient records.
company.description: Metriport is a healthcare data infrastructure company that provides tools for accessing, integrating, and analyzing patient records. Its platform connects healthcare data sources such as EHRs, health information exchanges, pharmacies, and laboratories, then normalizes the data into a unified FHIR-based format. Services include medical record retrieval, real-time event notifications, APIs, data warehousing, AI-powered record summaries, care gap identification, condition analysis, referrals, and clinical data exchange.
